Rationale: A motorcycle is executing a cut-in maneuver from the adjacent lane into the ego vehicle's path at a close forward distance (18.8 m). The ego vehicle is traveling at 50 kph, and the motorcycle's lateral movement directly threatens the ego's trajectory. A mild deceleration (A1) is the appropriate defensive response to increase the following distance and accommodate the cut-in safely.
